name: CROSS_WORKSPACE_ANCHORS
house: House of Orange / ARCHON Psi Atelier
scope: Registry of artifacts produced in sibling threads or other workspaces that are ANCHORED but NOT ABSORBED into this thread's lane system. Each entry preserves the artifact's provenance (sha256 + locator) so cross-thread references resolve, but the artifact body is not imported here. Distinct from Antechamber (which is for items pending lane assignment within this thread).

inclusion_criteria: Artifact has a verifiable anchor (sha256, artifact ID, or commit ref)
Artifact is referenced from at least one document in this repo (citation, comparison, fork note)
Architect has explicitly ratified anchor logging (MARK_EXTERNAL disposition)
exclusion_rules: Anchored entries are NOT canon — they cannot be substrate for HPBI Level-3 claims
Anchored entries do NOT appear in Lane manifests as assets
Promotion to a Lane requires explicit architect ratification (SEAL_HERE disposition) plus body import
